title: Stack buffer overflow via strcpy
root_cause: strcpy() has no idea how big the destination buffer is, so it writes every byte of the source string even when that runs past the end of the stack buffer.
defenses: Never use strcpy, strcat, sprintf, or gets.
Use snprintf with the destination's real size and check the return value.
Run AddressSanitizer in testing and fuzz any function that copies external input.
